svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A plate 3 mm thick, 20 mm tall and 84 mm wide, with an 18 mm tab on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thumb side holding an 11 mm finger loop. Print it in red.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two slots 1.6 mm tall run in from the little-finger edge to 36 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: past the centre, 5.4 mm above and below the motor axis height,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the plate slides off all eight tendons at once.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: between the anchor block's front face and the cover, in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.4 mm gap the cover's four spacers leave; the pucks press it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the block. Pull the loop toward the thumb side to free it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the cover screwed on, it slides out and back by hand.
